text:
Acme - Lisa: Hey team — starting ~02:12 UTC our completions suddenly look garbled and are much shorter. Responses return 200 but the text has weird tokens and truncated sentences. We noticed response metadata showing served_region=us-east-1 while our requests target eu-west-1. Model in response metadata: redwood-compat-lite-v0.8 but we expect redwood-4b-v2 (tokenizer v3). Trace: tr-1a2b3c. Also hit an unexpected billing jump (roughly 4x tokens billed).
alex (support): Thanks for the report Lisa — sorry about that. Can you paste the exact request (headers + body) and a short before/after output example? Also the earliest timestamp you saw the issue.
Acme - Lisa: Earliest: 2026-03-16T02:12:15Z. Curl we used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ***" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Client-Id: acme-123" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-4b-v2","input":"Summarize the following...","max_tokens":512}'
```
Response snippet (returned):
```
{"id":"resp-9","model":"redwood-compat-lite-v0.8","served_region":"us-east-1","output":"\uFFFD\uFFFD\uFFFD short text"}
```
maria (oncall): I'm starting a routing/failover check. @jonathan can you look at standby mappings for eu-west? If a standby variant that isn't tokenizer-compatible got swapped in that's probably the root cause.
jonathan (eng-runtime): Checking logs: at 02:11:55 our autoscaler marked eu-west capacity as saturated and routed flows to standby pools. The standby mapping for the redwood-4b-v2 family had a lite quantized fallback (redwood-compat-lite-v0.8). That variant uses a different vocab/tokenizer (v2) — tokenizer mismatch explains the garbled bytes and changed token counts. That's a bug: router allowed fallback without verifying tokenizer metadata.
kyle (infra): Autoscaler spike originated from a short-lived burst in a partner tenancy that consumed reserved slots; we triggered cross-region failover per policy. We're investigating throttling knobs.
alex (support): Interim: Lisa, can you try forcing the eu-west region again by adding the header `X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1` (you already have it, but if that doesn't help try `model:redwood-4b-v2` + `fallback:false` in the body). Example:
```
{"model":"redwood-4b-v2","input":"...","max_tokens":512,"fallback":false}
```
jonathan (eng-runtime): I've pushed an emergency router rule: block redwood-compat-lite-v0.8 from being used as a fallback for the 4b-v2 family. We'll also roll back the standby mapping in eu-west to the previous compatible variant. Expected propagation ~10-15m.
anna (customer-success): Hi Lisa — I'm opening a billing investig ticket and will request a credit for the token spike. @billing-bot please create a ticket.
billing-bot: Created billing ticket #B-4572 and linked to support thread 2760012345.
Acme - Lisa: Posting quick before/after examples — before (normal): "The summary: Our quarterly..." After (during issue): "\uFFFD short text". Token counts: expected ~420 tokens, returned 28 tokens.
jonathan (eng-runtime): Can confirm rollback applied at 02:24:05 UTC and router rule in place to prevent that incompatible fallback. I'm following up with a full postmortem. Root cause: fallback selection didn't validate tokenizer compatibility metadata.
maria (oncall): I see the rule hit and traffic is back to eu-west serving compatible variants. Can you re-run your request now @Acme - Lisa?
Acme - Lisa: Re-ran at 02:26:20 UTC — outputs look correct again, token counts back to expected and no garbled chars. Billing spike still shows on our side but much smaller now. Thanks :thumbsup:
alex (support): Glad it's fixed. Next steps we will: 1) keep the temporary block on that lite variant for the 4b family, 2) add a router pre-check for tokenizer compatibility (ETA 2d), 3) billing team to propose credit (Anna to follow up). I'll post a short incident summary later.
anna (customer-success): I'll own the billing follow-up and send you the ticket link once the credit is approved.
jonathan (eng-runtime): We'll also add a unit test to ensure fallback selection compares `vocab_id` + `tokenizer_version` before routing. Apologies for the disruption.
Acme - Lisa: Appreciate the quick response and workaround. Please keep me posted on the postmortem and billing outcome."
